description: Show one resource instance's attribute values from the current Terraform state (terraform show -json). Read-only: never locks, never refreshes. Sensitive values are redacted: Terraform's own markers, plus values equal to a marked one, secret-like names and secret-shaped strings; a footer says what was hidden and why.

address.description: Exact resource instance address from tf_state_addresses, e.g. aws_instance.web[0] or module.db.aws_db_instance.this["primary"]

dir.description: Terraform root module directory (must already be initialized). Default: TERRAFORM_CWD_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

include_null.description: Also list attributes whose value is null

name: tf_show_resource
